name: Study candles
summary: Something ambient to leave open during finals: a shelf with a candle for each friend in a dark room; light yours for as long as you plan to study and it burns down in real time while the room glows warmer with every lit candle, then blow it out or add wax, and burned-out candles leave a stub, a curl of smoke and how long they lasted.
useWhen: locking in for 3 hours, who's in
dontUseWhen: finding friends at the library in person (use fenwick-lights)
scheduling a study session for later (use meeting-time)
quizzing each other (use exam-quiz or flashcard-relay)

sub.description: Line under the title: the chat and the week

candles.description: Friends who already lit a candle

mins.description: How long they planned to study, 30 to 360 minutes

what.description: What they're studying, one or two words

said.description: What they said, in their words
